name: Blade of Vaulted Secrets
label: Quest
description: Blade of Vaulted Secrets: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Qiraji and their servants wield items made with the rarest and finest materials: bones from gargantuan ancient creatures, gems from the depths of the earth, metals pure and strong.

Just the sight of Qiraji artifacts fills me with an urge to practice my craft with their shattered and smelted pieces. Prove your allegiance to the Circle, friend, and I will make you a powerful weapon from the finest Qiraji materials.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you bring me the components I require, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You've done well, adventurer. This is a masterwork hilt... The balance is perfect.
Take your weapon, friend. Wield it with great confidence and vanquish our enemies!
